Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: public GitHub document header image for a security page
Primary request: one wide frame that says without words: the client's material stays on this table, and what comes from outside stops at its edge.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column; Image 3 is the project character sheet and Image 4 is the project prop sheet. Images 3 and 4 are binding.
Subject: Themis exactly as on the character sheet — same face, braided crown with one braid over the left shoulder, a wide marble band covering BOTH EYES completely, chiton and mantle with deep folds, gold scales HELD level in her raised hand with the chains hanging straight down, and the marble-blade sword with gold fittings lowered and supported in her other hand.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. A marble table stands across the lower half. On it lies the THIN flat matte-gold client folder from the prop sheet, closed, with Themis's open palm resting flat on it. Thin sky-blue threads come in from the left across the ivory ground, reach the table edge and stop there, ending in small blue arrowheads that point at the edge and go no further. The classical white-marble column stands at the right. Generous empty ivory space.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble sculpture render, warm ivory Apple-like presentation, white marble, physically plausible materials
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and confident
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, sky blue #B8D6EA for the incoming threads, muted gold #C9A87A for the folder and the sword fittings, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints: figure and objects match the project bible exactly; blindfold covers both eyes with no gap; nothing floats and nothing balances on a point; the hand on the folder is anatomically correct with five fingers and one readable thumb; highest final quality; maximum resolution
Avoid: visible eyes, a thick or leather folder, floating scales, a sword standing on its tip, dark background, neon, purple gradient, smoky lighting, watermark, owl, helmet
